source_metadata: locked 01_locked_source_manifest.csv, restricted to the 23 immutable identities; source_group/domain/scene/machine/role are descriptive labels only

aggregation.source_cluster: Each source contributes equally within its specified cohort; windows are not independent clusters.
aggregation.five_horizon_cohort_ci: Read existing paired 20000-draw percentile source-cluster CI from sealed bootstrap CSV without recomputing primary.
aggregation.five_horizon_macro: Per source mean of five MAEs, then equal-source mean; exploratory CI from the already sealed shared draw table.
aggregation.source_group_sensitivity: PLE and WSR are equal-source means; PSM is source-balanced weighted median of post-lag cells using sealed S arrays, NA if no post cells.
aggregation.source_macro: For a source, seven-output macro MAE is the arithmetic mean of seven output MAEs at 120s.
aggregation.leave_one_source_out: Only 22-source descriptive point estimates; no gate or alternate primary population.
aggregation.correlation: Pearson and Spearman across 23 source-level paired deltas, each seed separately; descriptive only, no multiple-testing claims.
aggregation.rollout: For each source, mean absolute-error delta over its windows at each of 12 native 10s steps; then equal-source mean.
aggregation.bias: Signed prediction minus truth; compare bias and RMSE alongside MAE.

limitations: The three seeds share training and population structure and are not independent statistical replicates; seed mean/median are descriptive only.
Small scene/domain groups are descriptive only; no source is dropped from the original result.
Historical preprocessing provenance remains PARTIALLY_UNRESOLVED; 87/90 available development sources matched bitwise.
Head parameter drift and metric correlations are associations, not causal proof.
